redfin.remarks: Wake up to unobstructed, floor-to-ceiling views of the Downtown Los Angeles skyline from this 2-bedroom, 2-bathroom condo. Set on the penthouse floor of MURA, one of Downtown LA’s luxury condominium communities, this residence pairs an exceptional location in the heart of the Arts District with amenities including 24-hour front-desk security, a pool, hot tub, courtyard, grill area, and recently renovated gym . With over $90,000 in permitted renovations to the unit, this residence is a sophisticated, turnkey home. Thoughtful upgrades extend throughout the residence, including waterproof luxury vinyl tile flooring in the main living areas, carpeted bedrooms, Lutron dimmable smart switches, a Nest thermostat, and custom motorized window shades that are both voice- and smart-home compatible. An Arlo smart doorbell and Schlage smart entry lock add another layer of convenience. The kitchen is equipped with a GE range, Whirlpool convection microwave and refrigerator, and Bosch dishwasher, while an LG washer and dryer complete the residence. This unit also offers two additional amenities that are rarely found together in Downtown living: deeded tandem parking for two cars and an exceptionally large deeded storage locker (approximately 14’ x 11’) that is ideal for storing bikes, sporting equipment, luggage, seasonal items, or simply keeping the residence beautifully uncluttered. Step outside and the best of the Arts District is at your doorstep, with acclaimed museums, restaurants, coffee shops, galleries, boutiques, and some of Downtown’s most exciting destinations just moments away.
